Context: 8. Disbursement of advance and time-limits for utilization.-

- (b) For purchase/ construction of new flat.Either in one lumpsum or in convenient instalments at the discretion of the Head of Department. The employee should execute the agreement in prescribed form before the advance/first instalment of advance is paid to him/her. The amount drawn by the employee should be utilized for the purchase/ construction of the flat within one month. - Rule 8 (ii).
